# Learnset regression fixtures

These files retain only the assertions used by `audit_learnset_variety.py`
and `test_learnset_variety.py` from the October 2, 2026 learnset review and
implementation receipt. The original reports are recoverable from Git commit
`322533c4b38c2f212bc339576205822e5cb5114f` under `_ai_artifacts/reports/`.

The review fixture records approved additions and original level-up/TM moves.
The implementation fixture records reminder repairs, restored moves, utility
tutor flags, approved assignments, and TM compatibility changes.

Keep these as fixed regression expectations rather than generating them from
the current game data, which would hide regressions.
